Microsoft: $2.5B. AWS: $1B. OpenAI: $4B+. Anthropic: $1.5B. They're not just building models — they're building armies of engineers to deploy them inside enterprises.

The market is splitting between people who can TRAIN models (shrinking demand, concentrated at big labs) and people who can DEPLOY systems (exploding demand, everywhere). Agentic orchestration, RAG pipelines, evaluation, cost optimization — these are the deployment skills companies are paying for.
